items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new spend, monetization forecasts, ROI claims, margin claims, and revenue projections this cycle. AI usage for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 is $997.51762695 across 5,522 calls, or approximately $0.18065 per recorded call, with 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all commission remaining in an aggregate unattributed row. Site-attributed commission is $0. Therefore revenue is supported only as $4.92 aggregate provider revenue, not as site revenue, and contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, and payback are not calculable. The AI and revenue windows differ, and infrastructure, domains, labor, and other direct costs are absent. Minimum measurement is a dated ledger keyed by site, request, and experiment that reconciles AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, and external spend to site/content identifiers, affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, and measurement windows. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as click-only and slot-gated after the CTO releases capacity; do not claim revenue or lift.

Financial disposition: retain the existing revenue-attribution boundary. Require every new affiliate link to use a registered site tracking ID; keep provider aggregate rows explicitly unattributed; do not assign the $4.92 aggregate commission to any site or use 6,219 clicks, 28 orders, or 6 shipped items as proof of profitable growth. The monthly AI total of $997.52 cannot be compared directly with the one-day revenue extract to produce margin because the periods and cost coverage do not match.

Do not admit new finance, AI-optimization, site-factory, prototype, or marketing work while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 57 improvements are measuring, and 21 implementation requests have failed. The existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case remains the capacity gate; after one slot is released, the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement may proceed with affiliate-click measurement only. Forecasts based on impressions, sessions, conversions, proposal counts, or AI call volume remain unsupported without attributable revenue and complete direct-cost coverage.
